page_title: BAR 1-0 GET | Barcelona v Getafe 25/09/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+4' Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Marc Casado (Barcelona) and blew his whistle. A free kick has been awarded to Getafe.
90+2' The attendance for today's match is 44407.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Inigo Martinez (Barcelona) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
89' Carles Perez (Getafe) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
88' Substitution. Pau Cubarsi will be replaced by Hector Fort (Barcelona).
88' Hansi Flick prepares a substitution. Alejandro Balde is replaced by Gerard Martin (Barcelona).
87' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Diego Rico (Getafe) replaces Djene.
87' There's an opportunity for Luis Milla (Getafe) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
86' Borja Mayoral (Getafe) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked. Getafe force a corner. They send men into the box.
84' Bertug Yildirim (Getafe) was standing in a clear offside position, making it an easy call for the linesman.

82' What a chance that is! Raphinha (Barcelona) squanders a huge opportunity as he latches on to a perfect cross from the wing. He and produces a bullet header from around the penalty spot which goes well wide of the left post! The ball goes out of play and Getafe will have a goal kick.
82' A cross into the box from Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) is cleared.
80' A substitution has been made. Christantus Uche is replaced by Bertug Yildirim (Getafe).
79' Raphinha (Barcelona) is awarded a yellow card.
78' Eric Garcia (Barcelona) strikes the rebound, but it goes well over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Getafe will have a goal kick.
77' Hansi Flick has decided to substitute Robert Lewandowski and he is replaced by Pedri (Barcelona).
77' Carles Perez (Getafe) makes a strong challenge and Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes blows for a foul. A free kick to Barcelona.
76' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
76' Jules Kounde (Barcelona) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
74' Borja Mayoral (Getafe) is clearly in an offside position and the linesman raises his flag.

71' What an opportunity! Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) smashed a first-time shot from the edge of the box, but the ball only crashed against the crossbar! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Getafe.
71' Raphinha (Barcelona) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.

71' Raphinha (Barcelona) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending the ball towards the bottom left corner only for David Soria to dive and make a save. The ball is out of play. Barcelona will have a chance to score from a corner.
70' Barcelona are awarded a mid-range free kick.
69' Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes shows a yellow card to Mauro Arambarri (Getafe) for his blatant foul.
67' Carles Perez (Getafe) fails to deliver a decent cross from the corner and the ball goes out of play.
63' Substitution. Ferran Torres (Barcelona) has come on for Pablo Torre.
63' Patricio Moreno Ruiz has decided to make a change. Mauro Arambarri (Getafe) replaces Yellu Santiago.
63' Substitution. Carles Alena walks off the pitch and Borja Mayoral (Getafe) comes on as a substitute.
63' Here is a change. Alex Sola is going off and Patricio Moreno Ruiz gives the last tactical orders to Abdoulaye Keita (Getafe).
60' Raphinha (Barcelona) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. It's a throw-in for Getafe.
59' Pablo Torre (Barcelona) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.

59' A sweet pass finds Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the top left corner. David Soria is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second. Barcelona have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
57' Luis Milla (Getafe) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
57' The ball is cleared after Christantus Uche (Getafe) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. Getafe win a corner.
56' Marc Casado (Barcelona) goes for goal but he blazes his shot well over the top.
56' Barcelona have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
56' Raphinha (Barcelona) tries to bend in the free kick from distance, but the defensive wall makes an easy block. Barcelona earn a corner.
55' Omar Alderete (Getafe) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes saw the whole situation. Barcelona have a free kick from a promising distance.
54' Alex Sola (Getafe) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Inaki Pena, who smothers the ball.
53' Jules Kounde (Barcelona) is caught offside by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
53' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Getafe.
52' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Pablo Torre (Barcelona) takes it short.
52' Alejandro Balde (Barcelona) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball. The ball goes out of play and Barcelona have been awarded a corner kick.
51' Pablo Torre (Barcelona) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
50' Raphinha (Barcelona) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. Barcelona will take a corner kick.
47' The Barcelona players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
46' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Carles Perez (Getafe) but poses no threat. The ball goes out of play and Barcelona will have a goal kick.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+1' Djene (Getafe) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
44' Djene (Getafe) commits a rough challenge and Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes blows his whistle for a foul. Barcelona will take a free kick near the side line.
43' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) sends a teasing cross into the area, but David Soria intercepts the ball.

41' What a great effort! Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) decides to unleash a long-range shot. Despite hitting it very well, it scorches inches wide of the right post. We could have witnessed a magnificent goal.
39' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.

39' Barcelona slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
37' The ball has crossed the sideline. Getafe are taking a throw-in.
36' The referee blows his whistle as Carles Perez (Getafe) was too aggressive in his challenge.
35' Alejandro Balde (Barcelona) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.

34' Omar Alderete (Getafe) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes no option but to blow his whistle. Barcelona have a free kick.
33' The ball spins up and hits the hand of Alex Sola (Getafe) after he fails to control it and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. That's a free kick to Barcelona.
33' David Soria pulls off a great save to deny Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick low drive to the bottom left corner.
31' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
30' Carles Perez (Getafe) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. A free kick is awarded to Barcelona.
29' Raphinha (Barcelona) latches on to a precise cross on the edge of the box and strikes the ball goalwards. However, it whistles wide of the right post so the goalkeeper can relax.
28' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Barcelona.
27' Alejandro Balde (Barcelona) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. Now Barcelona have a corner.
26' Raphinha (Barcelona) is in a clear offside position and the referee blows his whistle after the linesman raises his flag.
26' The linesman signals a throw-in for Getafe.
23' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) homes in on a magnificent reverse pass from Raphinha and strikes a crisp shot goalwards that just misses the left post.
22' Carles Perez (Getafe) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
21' Alejandro Balde (Barcelona) produces a long-range volley, but the ball was blocked by a defender on its way.
19' 1 - 0 Goal! Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) gathered the ball off a rebound inside the box and fired home into the bottom left corner.
18' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes blows his whistle for a foul.
18' Barcelona seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
17' Christantus Uche (Getafe) finds himself in an offside position and the referee stops play after the linesman raises his flag.
14' Raphinha (Barcelona) swings the ball into the box from the corner kick but it's a bit too strong and it goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Getafe.
14' Jules Kounde (Barcelona) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The ball goes out of play. Barcelona are awarded a corner kick.
12' Carles Perez (Getafe) wriggles into space and fires the ball from the edge of the area, but one of the defenders is there to block the effort.
11' Luis Milla (Getafe) fires the ball from distance, but it's blocked by a defender.
11' The referee stops play as the linesman flags Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) offside.

10' Yellu Santiago (Getafe) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent. It's a free kick to Barcelona, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
9' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Christantus Uche (Getafe).
8' Inaki Pena pulls off a fine save! Carles Perez (Getafe) attempts to head home after a precise cross into the box. He aims his header low towards the middle, but the effort is kept out.
8' Alex Sola (Getafe) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
7' Raphinha (Barcelona) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot.
6' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) makes a run beyond the last defender, but he's offside.
5' Barcelona continue the game with a quickly taken free kick.
5' Carles Perez (Getafe) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes blows for a foul. Barcelona are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
5' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
5' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
4' Foul! Eric Garcia (Barcelona) is penalised for pulling back his opponent. It's a free kick to Getafe, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
3' Getafe take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
2' Getafe work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
2' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Carles Perez (Getafe). The ball goes out for a corner. Getafe can continue in their attacking effort.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are on the pitch and Getafe will have the kick-off.
Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
